capabilities: Export notes as PDF files with custom page size, margins, and orientation
Preview paginated output live while editing markdown in a side-by-side panel
Insert manual page breaks with /// markers or automatic breaks before headings
Customize headers, footers, page numbers, backgrounds, and page frames
Print rendered documents directly to installed printers
extras: Desktop only; the README states it requires the Obsidian desktop app because it uses Electron's print pipeline. Edits made in the export panel are local and not synced back to the vault.
problem: Obsidian's built-in PDF export offers little control over page size, margins, typography, headers, footers, or page breaks.
summary: PDF export panel that renders notes into styled, paginated PDFs with a live preview, seven style presets, and full page layout controls.
